info.title: Baikor_R construction-site archive API
info.description: Construction-site lifecycle contract. Existing delete routes archive records and preserve UUIDs, areas, contacts, communications, attachments and metadata. Archived UUIDs and historical conflict links remain readable. General updates (PUT /api/construction-sites/{id}), status changes and attachment upload/deletion reject archived records with 409 constructionSites.archived. Attachment listing/download remain available to Viewer accounts. Both public GeoServer views exclude archived sites. Detection clears existing conflicts while retaining evidence and review history; disabled rules retain deferred reconciliation. Restore retains status and dates and re-enables ordinary eligibility checks. These private operations do not grant business or privacy publication approval. See README.md for related import and routes/alerts contracts.

get.summary: List active or archived construction sites
get.description: Requires Viewer permission. Filters before the existing maximum of 2,000 records. Results are ordered by creation time descending, then title ascending. No pagination parameter. Archived data remains private.

parameters.name: archive
parameters.description: active excludes archived records; archived returns archived records; all returns both.

delete.description: Requires Editor permission. Preserves the existing DELETE contract with no request body or supplied version. Sets IsDeleted=true and updates UpdatedAt; related records and historical alert evidence remain stored. Repeating archive for an already archived UUID returns 204 without another change. Concurrent row updates can return 409. Both bearer and browser-cookie requests require X-CSRF-TOKEN and the antiforgery cookie obtained from GET /api/antiforgery using the same authenticated identity. These endpoints retain the global AutoValidateAntiforgeryToken requirement.

post.description: Requires Editor permission. Preserves the existing route, request and deletedCount response. All selected UUIDs must exist before any archive changes are saved. Already archived records remain archived and count toward deletedCount, so repeating a selection is idempotent. Related records/source identities remain stored. There is no 500-record selection cap; database reads are batched internally. Both bearer and browser-cookie requests require the antiforgery cookie and X-CSRF-TOKEN obtained from GET /api/antiforgery using the same authenticated identity. These endpoints retain the global AutoValidateAntiforgeryToken requirement.

200.description: All selected existing records are archived. deletedCount includes already archived records.

post.description: Requires Editor permission. Supply the current version from a UUID read. Sets IsDeleted=false and updates UpdatedAt without changing status, dates, source identity or related records. Successful changes return the new version. An already active record with the current version returns 200 without another change. Stale versions are rejected even when already active. Restore never creates another construction site. Both bearer and browser-cookie requests require the antiforgery cookie and X-CSRF-TOKEN obtained from GET /api/antiforgery using the same authenticated identity. These endpoints retain the global AutoValidateAntiforgeryToken requirement.

200.description: Restored record, or already active record with the current version.

ConstructionSiteId.name: id
ConstructionSiteId.description: Retained construction-site UUID. ASP.NET applies a GUID route constraint.

BearerAuth.description: Access token from Authentication:Authority with aud containing Authentication:ClientId (normally baikor-r). Required permissions derive from the top-level roles claim. The dedicated baikor_importer role is excluded. Archive, bulk archive and restore also require antiforgery cookie/header protection under the existing global MVC filter.

BrowserCookie.name: __Host-BaikorR.Auth
BrowserCookie.description: Authenticated browser session. Mutations also require the antiforgery cookie and X-CSRF-TOKEN obtained from GET /api/antiforgery.

CsrfHeader.name: X-CSRF-TOKEN
CsrfHeader.description: Required for archive, bulk archive and restore with either bearer or browser-cookie authentication. Obtain GET /api/antiforgery using the same authenticated identity, retain its antiforgery cookie and send the returned token.

AntiforgeryCookie.name: __Host-BaikorR.Antiforgery
AntiforgeryCookie.description: Required together with X-CSRF-TOKEN for archive, bulk archive and restore, including bearer requests. Retain this cookie from GET /api/antiforgery using the same authenticated identity. Authentication-disabled local profiles use BaikorR.Antiforgery instead.

version.description: PostgreSQL xmin optimistic concurrency version. Read the current value before restoring.
